provenance: Claude, 2026-09-24, traffic-v9 (419151b) against traffic-v10 (stop and dwell, design/INTERSECTIONS.md), driver-v5, street-line-v3, pass-v3, alder-slice-v8.
method: Soak: scripts/traffic-soak.ts <seed> --json, traffic alone ten minutes a seed, standing below 0.5 m/s. 'widest' is v10 with step 1's first amber axis (the widest single arm), which stopped the through road at 12 T-junctions; 'v10' is the axis as shipped (the straight-through pair). Gate kinds: every gate race with contact replayed by rival:scene, its contacts classified by the traffic car's heading against the rival's and de-duplicated by (seed, time, route metres); 'crossing, claimed' is a car crossing that claimed its junction within 15 s before.
soakFinding: Every car still standing after ten minutes, in v9 and v10 alike, is in one undressed cluster around (-650, -1080), about 300 m across (lanes 262 to 554); its lock (a car holding its chain and unable to move, a queue behind) is v9's. The longest stand is a lottery: its lane differs in every version.
gateFinding: v9's 9 crossing incidents were all claimed from undressed approaches; v10's 8 are 6 undressed, one priority (claimed on the move from 34 m, rule 1) and one from a stop bar after the dwell, with the rival crawling 7 m away at 6 mph, under RACER_MOVING. 59 of the map's 172 junctions of three or more arms are undressed (56 withheld whole because one approach could not fit paint or a pole, 3 acute merges), so the rule does not reach where the gate's crossings are. gen-54 at seed 271828 (off the pavement 70 ticks, 9.5 s slower) is a van claiming at an undressed junction from 30 m, the rival 263 m away: the old reckoning, met at another moment.
